review_checklist: Run the main user flow end-to-end — does it complete without errors?
Read the actual output — would Emerson immediately see something wrong?
Trace one UI→backend data path: does the parameter arrive in server logs?
Check for JS/frontend runtime errors (not just syntax)
Test at realistic scale (not toy inputs)
Verify output actually exists (files on disk, DB records written)
MANDATORY for web apps: Open deployed URL in Chrome MCP and verify page renders correctly
notes: Static site on GitHub Pages served from docs/ on main. Local preview: cd docs && python3 -m http.server 8812. Data pipeline: build.py -> docs/data.json.
